snippet.title: I'm Making a Monster - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
The full game is here!!!

Piece by piece, you pour your soul into the monster. This is your burden and you bear it willingly. Your friends think that this is unhealthy.

Check it out on Steam or itch.io

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4047160/Im_Making_a_Monster/ 

https://zorkie.itch.io/im-making-a-monster
